title: Canonical closed tensor-Hom representative model on a ringed site
statement: Let $J$ be a ringed site with commutative coefficient ring sheaf $A$, module category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and its recorded derived internal Hom $H$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. A closed tensor-Hom structure for $H$ consists of a monoidal structure whose right tensor by $L$ is left adjoint to $H(L,-)$, with counit evaluation natural also in $L$. Its tensor bifunctor, transposition and internal composition are the tensor, Hom equivalence and transpose of the composite evaluations of these adjunctions. A canonical K-flat representative model for it is a natural isomorphism from localization of the actual total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] on pairs of K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex] to the derived tensor of their localizations, with the following fixed normalization. Use the actual Hom representative, product projections, K-injective replacement $I(M)$, localization factorization and inverse localized augmentation [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation]. For K-flat $P,L$ and every $\phi:P\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,I(M))$, there is a chain map $\psi:\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes L)\to I(M)$ sending each actual sheafified pure-tensor summand $x\otimes y$ to $\phi(x)(y)$; the comparison followed by the closed transpose inverse of the localized $\phi$ equals $Q(\psi)$ followed by the inverse localized augmentation. The pure tensor generator uses the actual sheafification unit and total-complex summand inclusion, not a chosen map. The total tensor preserves K-flatness. Universes are independent for site objects, arrows and coefficients, with module universe $\max(c,v,u)$. This is a representative characterization of the existing derived tensor and internal Hom, not a second derived tensor construction.

source.place: Tags 06YN and 07A4 for the K-flat total tensor; Tags 08J9 and 0A98 for closed tensor-Hom evaluation and composition. The general ringed-site representative normalization used in proof steps 5-6 of lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus.

proof.text: For the total-tensor K-flatness clause, install the recorded monoidal and symmetric structures at coefficient universe max(c,v,u). Tensoring on the left preserves coefficient-sized colimits and is additive by lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits. Shrink colimit preservation to universe-zero diagrams and transfer it and additivity to right tensoring by the braiding. The four tensor additivity equations give MonoidalPreadditive, so Mathlib's total-complex associator applies. All auxiliary instances are local to the proof.
Given an acyclic test complex F, apply the defining K-flatness condition of P to F, and then that of Q to Tot(F tensor P). Thus Tot(Tot(F tensor P) tensor Q) is acyclic.

Use HomologicalComplex.associator F P Q from Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.Monoidal to identify this complex with Tot(F tensor Tot(P tensor Q)). Transfer exactness degree by degree with HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.of_iso. The total tensor in coefficientTotalTensor is definitionally the same mapBifunctor totalization, so this proves coefficientTotalTensor_isKFlat with its signature unchanged. The other declarations remain the original concrete constructions and representative characterization.
